title: 1 carat vs 2 carat on a size 6 finger

post.youtube_title: 1 carat vs 2 carat on a size 6 finger
post.caption:
On a size 6 finger, a 1 carat round covers 39% of the width and a 2 carat covers 49%. Twice the carat is only 1.6 mm wider.

Round diamond size chart: https://www.heygema.com/en/gem-size/round-diamond-size-chart?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=shorts&utm_campaign=gem_size_shorts

Estimates for a well-cut stone.
